settings.editor: When nobody is taking responsibility for the original installation, a clear inspection can help you regain control of the situation. The report gives structure to what is visible, what the system history suggests, and what still needs further confirmation. It is especially useful before buying, selling, repairing or planning upgrades around an existing solar system.

A baseline check can save confusion later when performance changes or another contractor needs to understand the system. Photos, visible condition notes and monitoring context help make future repair decisions less vague. For unsupported systems, that record can become the starting point for practical next steps.
